title: Add Lottie renderer and creative-desk model zoo to Vultus
description: Turn Vultus into a renderer-neutral avatar model host with procedural and Lottie models. Add original, distinct Editor, Reporter, Copy Writer, and Illustrator characters for Chatticus and integrate them into the marketing site and workspace.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on Vultus branch codex/vultus-model-zoo through commit b209b4341753b3eb4e42e32d1e1d3b0fb8af17d5. Chatticus integration and visual verification remain in progress.

comments.author: home
comments.text: The Vultus renderer/model zoo is integrated into both Chatticus surfaces with original Editor, Reporter, Copy Writer, and Illustrator Lottie models. All four models were inspected at multiple animation frames, and marketing/workspace builds and tests pass against the pinned Vultus commit. Integration has not landed, so this story stays in progress.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Post-rebase integration validation remains green for the Vultus renderer/model zoo and four original Lottie role models. The integration has not landed, so the story stays in progress.
